summary: Report separate completed-response latency denominators for known work actions

replay.detail: Request timing remains in memory; no source, projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No persisted tables, indexes or migrations.

rules.detail: No admission, authority, ordering, lease or durable acknowledgement changes.

compatibility.detail: The existing request-latency routes array retains aggregate rows and fields, adds scope/duration_scope/population metadata and separate POST work-action rows with static action keys. Consumers must select scope=work-action for a renew denominator and must not sum overlapping route/action scopes. Applies from all preceding binaries; no intermediate migration.

manual.detail: No operator steps required. Metric consumers can select the documented action scope.

recovery.detail: Counters reset on process restart; ordinary binary rollback restores aggregate-only telemetry without changing durable state.
